description: Score a resume for ATS compatibility. Returns an overall score, section scores, the keywords the resume matches and the ones it is missing, and specific rewrite suggestions. Pass job_description to score against a posting, or omit it for a general ATS readiness score. Requires a connected AI Applyd account and uses the user's credits. Do not use it to rewrite the resume; use aiapplyd_optimize_resume. Next: aiapplyd_optimize_resume rewrites the resume against the same posting. resume_text is optional: the user can paste or attach a resume in the chat, and you pass its text as resume_text. Without it, the tool uses the resume already on the user's account. In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description (optional, omit for a general ATS readiness score)

resume_file.description: In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file. It is downloaded once, right away: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume. The resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation, as plain text. Omit it to use the resume already on the user's AI Applyd account.

name: aiapplyd_score_resume
title: Score Resume
